title: Austin Expands Voting for New Residents
summary:
*   An emergency meeting was convened to quickly address an urgent election matter.
*   City officials approved an ordinance to establish new voting precincts and polling places.
*   This action was critical to ensure that residents in recently annexed areas could participate in the upcoming May 1991 municipal elections.
transcript:
FOUNDIN
Austin City Council
MINUTES
EMERGENCY SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - March 20, 1991 TOWN LAKE CENTER
-
2:00 Ρ.Μ.
Mayor Cooke called to order the Emergency Special Called Meeting, noting the absence of
Mayor Pro Tem Urdy and Councilmember Carl-Mitchell. The Mayor stated the purpose of the
meeting was for consideration and passage of an ordinance.
ORDINANCE
Approved an ordinance amending Ordinance No. 910314-E and Ordinance No.
910314-H to add precincts and polling places for the area annexed by Ordinance No.
901218-A for the municipal elections to be held in May, 1991.
On Councilmember Barnstone's motion, Councilmember Nofziger's second, 5-0 Vote, Mayor Pro
Tem Urdy, Councilmember Carl-Mitchell absent. ADJOURNMENT The meeting, which was called to
order at 3:09 P.M., was adjourned at 3:11 Ρ.Μ.
